_doc: THE ONE hand-authored declaration of the fleet facts that no other file carries: who the providers are (account / plan / cost source / console links), the electronics that are not mesh peers, what the peers run and do, the non-bucket storage backends, and the domain's registration. It deliberately restates NOTHING that is declared elsewhere: VMs, IPs, WireGuard IPs, regions and disks are READ from config.json (via the consolidated export), the S3 buckets from the consolidated `storage`, the devices that are mesh peers from superapp-users.json (users.<u>.peers, whose wg_client resolves to the WireGuard row), and the zone's DNS records from c_vps/ba-clo_cloudflare/src/terraform.json. Consumers: cloud-u-android ac_cloud-c3 data/gen_fleet_slice.py (the Infra section's Providers / VMs / Storage / Electronics / Domains pages). A fact added here is a DATA edit; no code names it.

providers.label: Hetzner
providers.use: Terraform folder only (c_vps/vps_hetzner); no server is declared

providers.label: Amazon Web Services
providers.use: SES mail sending and verification records; no EC2 instance is active

providers.label: Cloudflare
providers.use: Registrar, DNS zone, Email Routing, Tunnel, Workers

providers.label: GitHub
providers.use: Source repositories, Actions runners (x86), GHCR images, Releases

_doc_electronics: Mesh peers are NOT redeclared: `peer` names a key of superapp-users.json users.*.peers, which already carries the label, kind and wg_client (-> the WireGuard IPs). Only what that file lacks is declared here: the OS and the role. A device that is not a mesh peer (no WireGuard identity) is declared in full with `id`, `label`, `kind`. No tablet is declared: none is evidenced anywhere in the fleet declarations.

electronics.role: Primary phone: Termux host, mesh client

storage_backends.label: Google Drive
storage_backends.role: Personal cloud drive reached through cloud-drive-mcp / google-workspace-mcp
